links.outcome: Exam-style benchmark accuracy versus clinical risk of errors
links.effect: High exam accuracy (DeepSeek-V3.2 94.7%, ChatGPT-5.2 89.3% on 2025 CNMLE), yet error analysis found a substantial proportion of high-risk clinical errors across model versions.
links.quote: Error analysis showed no significant differences across model versions in error type classification or clinical risk rating, despite a substantial proportion of high-risk clinical errors.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance of various LLM versions (DeepSeek and ChatGPT series) on medical licensing examination questions and evaluates error types and clinical risk ratings, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
